title: Value Kaleidoscope: Engaging AI with Pluralistic Human Values, Rights, and Duties
benchmark_measurement: Agreement rates and missing perspectives on values, rights, and duties across different religious affiliations.
findings: No statistically significant differences were found in agreement rates or reported missing perspectives across different religious groups for the evaluated values, rights, and duties.
